whyThisMatters:
A small studio ships utilities for Mac and iPhone. Wallper is the app in this listing: moving wallpaper on a Mac desktop, with controls for how it plays. The listing calls that a one-time lifetime purchase. The studio is in Czechia and started in May 2025.

Copier, on the same site, is a Mac clipboard manager. History is encrypted and syncs across Apple devices with iCloud, also on a one-time lifetime license. Calendarly puts an automated calendar on the iPhone lock screen. Locora is still unfinished: a city guide for iPhone and iPad, with skylines, streets, and local food.

Licenses are personal unless they say otherwise, and device limits can differ by app. Wallper is there to bring the desktop to life. You pick the wallpaper and how it moves, then you download it and pay once.
